name: documents
description: DOCX document production skills, published as an official ZCode plugin. Includes a read-only workspace viewer for shared reading, search, references and captures.

description_i18n.en: Word document production skills for DOCX: create, edit, format, review, and comment. Read together in a read-only workspace panel with anchor references, search, highlights and captures.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 面向 DOCX 的 Word 文档制作技能：创建、编辑、排版、审阅与批注。 支持工作区只读共同阅读、锚点引用、搜索、高亮与截图。
